 Woody Marks suffers knee injury in practice Wednesday, status uncertain 
 by Ari Koslow | Texans Correspondent | Thu, Nov 12th 2026, 12:54pm EST 
 Woody Marks dealt with mild knee discomfort Wednesday in practice and didn't finish practice for precautionary reasons. ( Aaron Wilson on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Marks was not seen to begin practice on Thursday. He will need to be monitored on the official injury report. 
 #Texans running backs Woody Marks dealt with mild knee discomfort Wednesday in practice and didn't finish practice for precautionary reasons, per league source. Not practicing so far today. Team taking wait-and-see approach on his status
— Aaron Wilson (@AaronWilson_NFL) November 12, 2026
